task.text:
[0] Heterozygous knockout of CAV1 didn't affect mice's lifespan. Life spans are determined from survival curves.

[1] Homozygous knockout of CAV1 reduced mice viability by 50% to the end of the second year of life. CAV1 -/- mice exhibited cardiac pathologies and pulmonary defects compared with wild-type mice of the same age. Life spans are determined from survival curves.

[2] Homozygous knockout of CAV1 reduced mice viability by 50% to the end of the second year of life. CAV1 -/- mice exhibited cardiac pathologies and pulmonary defects compared with wild-type mice of the same age. Life spans are determined from survival curves.

[3] 8-month-old mice with CDK7 knockout exhibited aging phenotypes and shortened lifespan. The Cdk7loxfrt allele carries the genetrap vector in the active orientation and prevents Cdk7 gene. This allele has been designated as Cdk7mut to indicate that it retains all the Cdk7 genomic sequences, yet it does not produce detectable Cdk7 transcripts or Cdk7 proteinexpression.

[4] Ink4/Arf locus encodes p16Ink4a and p15Ink4b proteins. Ink4/Arf-tg mice had a normal lifespan, not significantly different from wt mice (log rank test, P = 0.09) (Fig. 3B). Remarkably, however, Ink4/Arf-tg/tg mice presented a significantly different survival curve (logrank test, P = 0.001) with a more square shape. Median survival was extended from 27.5 months to 31.7 months, i.e. an extension of 15%.

[5] Authors replaced C/EBPα gene with C/EBPβ, generating the ββ alleles in the mouse genome. The ββ / αβ heterozygotes were served as a control.

[6] Authors replaced C/EBPα gene with C/EBPβ, generating the ββ alleles in the mouse genome. The ββ / αβ heterozygotes were served as a control.

[7] From C/EBPβ mRNA, three protein isoforms are synthesized through the usage of different translation initiation sites: two isoforms acting as transcriptional activators, liver-enriched activator protein (LAP)−1 and −2, and a transcriptional inhibitory isoform called liver-enriched inhibitory protein (LIP). Translation into LIP depends on a cis-regulatory uORF and is stimulated by mTORC1 signalling. In the present experiment a reduction of LIP expression was achieved by genetic ablation of the uORF.

[8] From C/EBPβ mRNA, three protein isoforms are synthesized through the usage of different translation initiation sites: two isoforms acting as transcriptional activators, liver-enriched activator protein (LAP)−1 and −2, and a transcriptional inhibitory isoform called liver-enriched inhibitory protein (LIP). Translation into LIP depends on a cis-regulatory uORF and is stimulated by mTORC1 signalling. In the present experiment a reduction of LIP expression was achieved by genetic ablation of the uORF.

[9] cbp-1 knockdown blocked eat-2 (CHRNA7 ortholog) mutation-induced lifespan increase. Age was counted from stage L4. Bacterial dilution for feeding was supplemented with FUDR, IPTG, and ampicillin.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
